title: Murmuration: profile-driven batch recommendation engine with guarded apply/rollback
creator: Priya Kumar
description:
Summary:
We need a continuously-running recommendation engine that profiles live workloads and emits conservative batching and KV-cache parameter suggestions per workload cohort. The engine should produce suggestions that balance cost savings with strict latency/regression guardrails and support automated safe-apply and rollback via the Console API.

Goals:
- Generate per-workload batching/caching profiles (microbatch size, max coalescence window, kv-prefetch horizon, prefix-cache TTL, prefer-quantized-variant) that are expected to reduce per-token cost without violating latency SLOs.
- Provide confidence scores and a safety plan for each recommendation so Console can perform canary or gradual rollouts.
- Expose a trial/run mode (shadow apply) to validate against production traces before applying.
- Automate rollback on signal regressions and provide actionable diagnostics for SRE/owner.

Constraints and non-goals:
- The engine will not change model weights or runtime kernels. It only suggests config changes for the serving layer.
- Avoid recommendations for workloads with insufficient sample size or highly variable tail latency.
- No per-request inference code changes.

Design overview:
1) Profiling pipeline:
- Continuous sampler collects per-request metadata: model, sequence_length, client_route, timestamp, p95/p99 latency per minute, tokens_generated, cache_hit_ratio, kv_cache_hits, concurrency, instance_type.
- Aggregation into 5-minute and 1-hour cohorted signatures: (model_family, route, avg_seq_bucket, request_rate_bucket).
- Compute stability metrics (coeff of variation for latency and throughput).

2) Heuristic engine:
- For stable cohorts (low cv), generate baseline suggestions using heuristics derived from lab experiments:
  - microbatch_target = clamp(round((median_throughput * target_latency_ratio) / gpu_util_factor), 1, 256)
  - coalescence_window_ms = min( max(estimated_interarrival_ms * burstiness_factor, 2), 200 )
  - kv_prefetch_horizon = if(cache_hit_ratio > 0.6 and median_seq <= 512) then 4 else 1
- Score suggestions by expected cost delta and risk index computed from stability and measured tail latency sensitivity.

3) Continuous parameterization:
- Suggestions are not single points but parameter distributions (e.g., safe-range: microbatch 4-16, aggressive-range 16-64).
- The Console will choose a rollout strategy: shadow -> canary -> gradual -> global. The engine provides safe step sizes and recommended cadence.

4) Safety and rollback:
- Define automated guard signals: latency_p95_increase_pct, error_rate_delta, tail_latency_spike_count, 95th token completion time increase.
- Canary rule: if p95 increases by >5% and absolute increase >8ms or error rate +0.2% in two consecutive windows -> automatic rollback to previous config.
- Add a cooldown window (15 minutes) before re-apply attempts and require manual override for repeated oscillation.

Telemetry and observability:
- Each suggestion emits: suggestion_id, cohort_signature, candidate_params, expected_cost_delta_pct, risk_score, sample_size, observed_shadow_delta metrics.
- Dashboards: Suggested vs Applied variance, rollback rate by cohort, cost saved (daily/7d), false-positive rate of recommendations.
- Alerting: Alert when rollback rate for a rollout >2% across cohorts in 24h.

APIs and artifacts:
- New service: batch-reckoner-service exposing endpoints: POST /suggestions/scan, GET /suggestions/{id}, POST /apply/{id}?mode={shadow,canary,gradual}.
- Console integration: UI card for each suggestion with quick actions (approve, schedule, apply, revert) + confidence band visualization.
- Config schema (yaml/json) will include: microbatch, coalescence_ms, kv_prefetch_horizon, kv_ttl_sec, safety_thresholds.

Data requirements / infra:
- Low-overhead request sampling (add lightweight envelope to existing request logs).
- Long retention for cohort signatures (30 days) to evaluate seasonal patterns.
- Datastore for suggestions and history (Postgres + time-series in ClickHouse/Bigtable).

Acceptance criteria:
- Engine generates accurate suggestions for >80% of stable cohorts in staging whose shadow apply shows cost reduction >=10% without p95 increase >2% over a 24h window.
- Automated canary apply+rollback works against a labeled canary fleet in staging with rollback occurring within 5 minutes of threshold breach.
- Console shows suggestion cards with clear confidence bands and a one-click apply/rollback.
- Documentation and runbook available for SRE and Customer Success teams.
